protocol_note: The prompt's PARALLEL-RUN PROTOCOL references 'the single method paragraph below', but no identifiable method paragraph is present in the prompt (flagged irregularity, also recorded by prior sessions). This preregistration therefore declares the single lane explicitly and the session stays inside it. Budget: at most 3 experiments.
single_method_paragraph: Coincident potential-field x strain ridge posterior with kernel-exact expected-DTI greedy emission. Sixteen label-free channels (multi-scale Hessian ridges, cross-scale persistence, tilt edges, gravity-magnetic orientation agreement) are computed fresh from the 19 competition bands; an unsupervised coincidence score (mean percentile rank of 8 independent-physics parts) is rank-fused 50/50 with a spatially out-of-fold HistGradientBoosting posterior trained on the shared 77-column label-free cache plus the 16 new channels (fold-visible catalogue only). Binary dots are emitted by a CELF greedy allocator that maximizes marginal expected TPw minus 0.2x expected FP mass under the exact 300 m triangular kernel, with a 2.05 px catalogue collar, 2.0 px guard spacing, and a fixed budget of 37,654 dots.
hypothesis: H-CPX-1: Concealed off-catalogue Quaternary faults produce coincident, orientation-agreeing ridges in gravity, magnetics, basement/conductivity and strain fields where single-field lineaments are mimicked by lithologic contacts; fusing that label-free coincidence with an OOF supervised posterior and emitting dots by exact expected-DTI (rather than fixed-spacing coverage) recovers withheld fault segments better than the matched 19-band baseline and the same surface under spacing-only allocation.
non_fault_mimic: Buried caldera ring margins and tilted Mio-Pliocene ash-flow tuff hogbacks dipping basinward, which can align gravity, magnetic and strain gradients without a through-going Quaternary fault; also alluvial-fan channel margins and survey seams.
